name: Iowa 4-H
org: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Iowa 4-H
what_you_do: Iowa only. Teens join county clubs and projects. Then they can join state programs such as State 4-H Council, State 4-H Recognition Day, State Project Area Awards and Youth Conference.
who_can_apply: Iowa only. Iowa youth in grades 4 to 12 (Clover Kids is K to 3).
pay_detail: Club members pay a $40 yearly fee. Some counties and programs charge more. Financial help is offered.
deadline_text: You can join at any time of year. State programs have their own application dates.
how_to_apply: Start on the Join 4-H page, or call 515-294-1017 or email iowa4hmail@iastate.edu. Your county Extension office can place you in a club.
